qa_rules.enforcement: Reviewers who miss calibration sentinels are retrained before receiving benchmark rows.

qa_rules.threshold: 2 independent reviews for every pilot, expansion, and source-acquisition candidate before promotion
qa_rules.enforcement: Single-reviewed rows remain in preflight queues and cannot be promoted.

qa_rules.threshold: required citation ids must exist and support the final label, not only a nearby fact
qa_rules.enforcement: Citation id, label, answer, and insufficiency/conflict mismatches go to adjudication or repair.

qa_rules.threshold: 100% of disagreements plus any invalid/calibration-failed reviewer batch
qa_rules.enforcement: Adjudication readiness must be regenerated before release after returned labels are imported.

qa_rules.threshold: agreement claims require completed reviewer pairs and non-null agreement metrics
qa_rules.enforcement: The paper must report unavailable agreement as unavailable while reviewer pairs are incomplete.
